user.title: Choose Transport Mode
user.description: Select how the integration connects to your Sungrow inverter.

cloud_credentials.title: Connect to iSolarCloud
cloud_credentials.description:
Enter your iSolarCloud API credentials. You can find them here: [iSolarCloud]({url})

After you submit, the hub is created and Home Assistant will prompt you to authorize it in your browser.

data_description.app_id: App ID from iSolarCloud Developer Platform. To find this, go to your application and look for 'id' within the URL like so: {app_id_url}.

modbus_host.title: Modbus Host
modbus_host.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your WiNet-S dongle for local Modbus communication.

local_setup.title: Local Modbus Setup
local_setup.description: Enter the connection details for your local WiNet-S dongle. No cloud account is required.

cloud_user.title: Connect with an iSolarCloud account
cloud_user.description:
Log in with your normal iSolarCloud app/web account (email + password) — no developer application required.

⚠️ This uses an unofficial API that may change or break without notice, and may be subject to Sungrow's terms of service. Your password is stored locally and never logged.

auth_callback.title: Waiting for authorization
auth_callback.description:
Open the link below to authorize the application:

{auth_url}

After you log in and approve the app, you will be redirected back and this screen will update automatically.

If the redirect does not complete (for example the page shows an error), wait a moment and you will be able to paste the code manually.

auth_manual.title: Enter Authorization Code
auth_manual.description:
The automatic redirect did not complete. Finish authorizing manually:

{auth_url}

**Instructions:**
1. Visit the link above and log in (skip if you already did).
2. You will be redirected (the page may show an error).
3. Copy the **code** parameter from the URL address bar.
4. Paste the code — or the full redirect URL — below.

data.code: Authorization Code or full redirect URL

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure iSolarCloud
reconfigure.description: Update your region or API credentials (the App ID stays the same). You'll be asked to authorize again in your browser, since new credentials or a new region require fresh tokens.

reconfigure_modbus_host.title: Update Modbus Host
reconfigure_modbus_host.description: Update the WiNet-S IP address for this hybrid (Cloud + Modbus) entry.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up local Sungrow inverter
zeroconf_confirm.description: A Sungrow **{model}** was discovered on your network at **{host}** (WiNet-S). Set it up as a **separate local entry** that reads the inverter over Modbus — fast, unmetered and offline-capable, with no iSolarCloud account required. If you also have a cloud entry for the same inverter, both stay independent (the local device is linked under the cloud plant when serials match).

reconfigure_modbus.title: Reconfigure local Sungrow inverter
reconfigure_modbus.description: Update the WiNet-S IP address if it changed on your network. This is a local Modbus connection — no iSolarCloud account is involved.

error.host_unreachable: The WiNet-S host is unreachable on port 502. Check the IP and ensure the dongle is online.
error.invalid_auth_code: iSolarCloud rejected the authorization code — it may have already been used or expired. Open the authorization link above to get a fresh code, then paste it here (or paste the full redirect URL).
error.invalid_extra_measure_points: Extra measure points must be in the form point_id=code, comma separated
error.invalid_redirect_uri: The Redirect URI must end with /api/sungrow_hass/callback. Update it here AND in the iSolarCloud developer portal so both match — otherwise iSolarCloud redirects to the Home Assistant homepage and the authorization code is lost.

abort.not_sungrow_device: The discovered device is not a supported Sungrow inverter.
abort.library_missing: The pysolarcloud library is not installed. Restart Home Assistant so the integration's requirements are installed, then try again.
abort.missing_code: Authorization code was not received. Please try again.
abort.missing_app_id: This entry is missing the App ID. Use Reconfigure to supply it.
abort.wrong_account: The authorized account does not match this integration's App ID. Use the original developer application.

init.title: Sungrow Options
init.description: Adjust how often Home Assistant polls iSolarCloud. Lower values update more frequently but use more of your API quota. The free plan allows ~2000 calls/hour; the minimum is 10 seconds.

data.enable_device_sensors: Create per-device sensors (EV chargers, meters, extra batteries)
data.modbus_host: WiNet-S Modbus host (enter to enable hybrid, clear to disable)

modbus_options.title: Local Modbus Options
modbus_options.description: Adjust how often Home Assistant reads the inverter directly over local Modbus. There is no cloud API quota, so you can poll frequently; the minimum is 10 seconds.

data.modbus_debug_daily_yield: Expose raw Modbus daily_yield register dump on the sensor (debug only)

whitelist_rejection.title: iSolarCloud rejected the request (whitelist)
whitelist_rejection.description: iSolarCloud is rejecting API requests for **{plant}** because this client's IP address or your account is not in your API application's whitelist (E918/E919). Add them in the iSolarCloud Developer Portal (or disable the whitelist); the integration recovers automatically once accepted.

rate_limited.title: iSolarCloud API rate limit reached
rate_limited.description: iSolarCloud is rejecting requests for **{plant}** because the API call limit was reached (E998/E999). Increase the polling interval in the integration options to make fewer calls; it recovers when the quota resets.

backfill_partial.title: Historical backfill finished with gaps
backfill_partial.description: The historical statistics backfill for **{plant}** finished but {failed_chunks} time range(s) could not be imported, so the History and Energy dashboards may have gaps for that period. Re-run **Developer Tools → Actions → Sungrow: Backfill historical statistics** to fill the gaps; the successful hours are already imported and re-running only overwrites them cleanly.

heartbeat_stopped.title: Dispatch keepalive stopped
heartbeat_stopped.description: The background keepalive that holds **{plant}** in forced charge/discharge mode stopped unexpectedly, so the inverter will time out of forced mode and the command is no longer being applied. Set the Charge/Discharge Command to Stop and back to Charge/Discharge to restart it; if it keeps happening, check the logs and open an issue.

dispatch_not_actuated.title: Dispatch command was not applied
dispatch_not_actuated.description: A forced charge/discharge command for **{plant}** was accepted by iSolarCloud, but the inverter stayed in Self-consumption instead of entering Forced mode, so the command is not taking effect. This can happen on some models/firmware or API plans. Try setting the Charge/Discharge Command to Stop and again to Charge/Discharge; if it persists, check the logs and open an issue.

dispatch_write_failed.message: Failed to update {param} on the inverter: {error}

backfill.name: Backfill historical statistics
backfill.description: Import historical iSolarCloud data into Home Assistant long-term statistics so the History and Energy dashboards are populated immediately.

config_entry.name: Integration
config_entry.description: The Sungrow (cloud) integration entry to backfill. Leave empty to backfill every loaded cloud entry.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Optional earliest date to import from (interpreted as UTC midnight). Defaults to the configured backfill window.

set_battery_mode.name: Set battery mode
set_battery_mode.description: Set the plant battery mode (Self-consumption / Force charge / Force discharge / Stop). Optional duration overrides Forced Dispatch Duration for this command only.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: Minutes before auto-revert to Self-consumption (0 = no auto-revert for this command). Omit to use Forced Dispatch Duration.

entity_id.name: Battery mode entity
entity_id.description: The Battery Mode select entity. Leave empty to target every battery plant.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Dispatch device that owns the battery mode select.
